BiblicalUsage: Kenani, Chenani, is a Levite who stood on the stairs and cried to God. Nehemiah 9:4 says Chenani stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Chenani's loud cry is the right answer to a rebuilt wall: the people prayed before they built, and they prayed when the building was done.
